name: Asukai Masatsune
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 94); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1221.

poems.title: Around Mount Miyoshino’s crest
poems.author: Asukai Masatsune
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 94
poems.text:
Around Mount Miyoshino’s crest
The autumn winds blow drear;
The villagers are beating cloth,
Their merry din I hear,
This night so cold and clear.

poems.title: 94. みよし野の 山の秋風 小夜更けて (Miyoshino no yama no akikaze sayo fukete)
poems.author: Asukai Masatsune
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
みよし野の 山の秋風 小夜更けて
故郷寒く 衣うつなり
